title: On generalized Turán problems for expansions
summary: Given a graph $F$, the $r$-expansion $F^r$ of $F$ is the $r$-uniform hypergraph obtained from $F$ by inserting $r-2$ new distinct vertices in each edge of $F$. Given $r$-uniform hypergraphs $\mathcal{H}$ and $\mathcal{F}$, the generalized Turán number, denoted by $\textrm{ex}_r(n,\mathcal{H},\mathcal{F})$, is the maximum number of copies of $\mathcal{H}$ in an $n$-vertex $r$-uniform hypergraph that does not contain $\mathcal{F}$ as a subhypergraph.
